Grossfeld]] and Yoshiko Miura |composername=Takahiro Yamautsuri |arrangername=Takahiro Yamautsuri |colorscheme=Hoenn }} '''Make a Wish''' is the ending theme for the English [[dub]] of ''[[M06|Jirachi: Wish Maker]]''. It is the English equivalent of [[A Small Thing]]. Early in the {{pkmn|movie}}, {{an|May}} tells {{Ash}} and {{an|Brock}} that [[Caroline|her mother]] used to sing it to her as a lullaby when she was a little girl, and then she sings it to [[Max]]. During the ending credits, a full version of the song is played with lyrics in both English and Japanese. This is the first time that the English dub left original Japanese lyrics in the song. The Japanese lyrics are performed by [[Asuca Hayashi]], and the English lyrics are performed by Cindy Mizelle and written by [[Norman J. Grossfeld]]. ==Lyrics== {{Schemetable|Hoenn}} !
